name: TableLink
description: TableLink is a reservation and table-management platform used by independent restaurants. The connector lets you find a TableLink restaurant, check live availability for any date and party size, and book or cancel a reservation on the diner's behalf — through the same platform the restaurant uses to run its floor. Returns only public restaurant data plus the diner's own bookings; never internal restaurant data or other diners' reservations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TableLink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TableLink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tablelink.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TableLink MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TableLink provides these MCP tools: search_restaurants, get_availability, book_reservation, and cancel_reservation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TableLink?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TableLink in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Get My eSIM, and Is It Legit by M8ven.
TableLink requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TableLink is developed by CR2 Creative. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
